parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that both marbles are white.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the two marbles come from bag B given that one is white and one is red.

text: Tim has two bags of marbles, A and B.
Bag A contains 8 white, 4 red and 3 yellow marbles.
Bag B contains 6 white, 7 red and 2 yellow marbles.
Tim also has an ordinary fair 6-sided dice. He rolls the dice. If he obtains a 1 or 2, he chooses two
marbles at random from bag A, without replacement. If he obtains a 3, 4, 5 or 6, he chooses two
marbles at random from bag B, without replacement.

parts.text:
How many different arrangements are there of the 12 people if Jai stands next to Kaz and
each friend stands next to his own wife?

parts.text:

middle positions in the line, with Jai’s five friends on one side and the five wives of the
friends on the other side?

of 4 and a group of 3.
